name: The Eastreach
description: The wet, wide country east of Bracken Ford, running up to the fells in the north and down into marsh in the south.

er_0_0.name: Brenn Lowland
er_0_0.description: Level pasture cut by slow brown streams. Telgard is a long way west.

er_0_1.name: Sedge Flats
er_0_1.description: Wet meadow and rushes under a low sky. Telgard is a long way west.

er_0_2.name: Frostfell Approach
er_0_2.description: Rolling heath with the wind combing it flat. Telgard is a long way west.

er_0_3.name: The Frost Door
er_0_3.description: A frost-white outcrop at the foot of the fell, with a low arch cut into it. Cold air flows out of the arch, and with it the smell of snow. Bring a light.

er_0_4.name: Cold Fell

er_0_5.name: Kalder Road
er_0_5.description: The road ends at the walls of Kalder, grey stone with a small gate open in it, on the edge of the northern fells.
